strategy.title: Prioritize BEST Visa Companies
strategy.description: Apply immediately to Cara Care (remote-first, Bayer-backed), Audatic (explicit immigration support, 36 applicants), and Jobgether (fully remote, <25 applicants). These offer the clearest path to Germany from Iran.

strategy.title: Target Recently Posted Jobs First
strategy.description: Audatic (7 hours), Jobgether (15 hours), and Flix (2 days) are fresh with lower competition. Apply within 24-48 hours for maximum visibility before applicant pools grow.

strategy.title: Focus on Python-Only Roles
strategy.description: 25 of 30 jobs require Python. Avoid Go-primary roles (GALVANY, Cresta) and prioritize Django/FastAPI positions where your 9+ years of experience is a clear differentiator.

strategy.title: Leverage Remote-First Positions
strategy.description: Cara Care, Jobgether, and Ebury offer remote work, allowing you to start contributing from Iran before relocating. This reduces visa timeline pressure significantly.

strategy.title: Target Berlin-Based Positions
strategy.description: 12 of 30 jobs are in Berlin. Local companies (Audatic, Sunday Natural, lemon.markets, Parloa) have easier relocation logistics and established visa processes for non-EU talent.

strategy.title: Apply to High-Salary Roles
strategy.description: Top-paying positions: Mobility House (€80K-€100K), Parloa (€80K-€100K), Jobgether (€80K-€100K). Your 9+ years experience qualifies you for senior compensation bands.

strengths.name: Python
strengths.detail: Primary language in 25/30 jobs. Your 9+ years of Python experience (Django, FastAPI, Flask) is the single strongest qualification across all listings.

strengths.name: Django
strengths.detail: Required in 8 jobs (Cara Care, Lumenaza, Sunday Natural, suena energy, etc.). Near-perfect match for Cara Care and Lumenaza stack requirements.

strengths.name: PostgreSQL
strengths.detail: Mentioned in 20+ jobs. Your production database expertise with complex queries, indexing, and optimization is highly valued across FinTech, HealthTech, and Green Tech sectors.

strengths.name: FastAPI
strengths.detail: Required in 12+ jobs (Engelhart, lemon.markets, exmox, WorkGenius, Parloa, Audatic, etc.). Your async Python experience is a key differentiator for modern API development roles.

strengths.name: Docker/Kubernetes
strengths.detail: Required in 15+ jobs. Container orchestration experience demonstrates production readiness for cloud-native architectures at scale.

strengths.name: AWS
strengths.detail: Mentioned in 10+ jobs. Cloud infrastructure experience with deployment, scaling, and DevOps practices aligns with most senior backend requirements.

strengths.name: REST API Design
strengths.detail: Core requirement in 18+ jobs. API architecture, documentation, and microservices design skills are consistently valued across all industries.

strengths.name: Redis/Celery
strengths.detail: Required in 6 jobs (Lumenaza, suena energy, Sunday Natural, etc.). Task queue and caching experience demonstrates understanding of distributed systems patterns.

weaknesses.name: Go
weaknesses.detail: Primary language in 3 jobs (GALVANY, Cresta co-primary, ARX Robotics). Go expertise would unlock additional high-paying positions at AI and Green Tech companies.

weaknesses.name: TypeScript/Node.js
weaknesses.detail: Required in 5 jobs (Parloa primary, ARX Robotics, Mobility House, The Exploration Company, Ebury). Full-stack TypeScript would increase match rate for AI and enterprise roles.

weaknesses.name: German Language
weaknesses.detail: BLOCKER: suena energy requires C1, EnopAI requires B2/C1. Learning German to B2 level would unlock 3-5 additional positions and improve long-term integration prospects.

weaknesses.name: Energy Trading Domain
weaknesses.detail: Appears in 4 jobs (Engelhart, suena energy, Lumenaza, EnopAI). Domain knowledge in algorithmic trading, energy markets, or grid optimization would strengthen applications.

weaknesses.name: ClickHouse/OLAP Databases
weaknesses.detail: Required at Cresta. Columnar database experience for analytics workloads would be valuable for AI/CDP platform roles.

weaknesses.name: Snowflake
weaknesses.detail: Required at Cirql One. Cloud data warehouse experience for enterprise semantic intelligence platforms.
